Remove the central miniature COMPLETELY including its painted background, arch/frame, figures and floor; remove the lower letter/text panel COMPLETELY including its frame and large capital. Remove the parchment around and BETWEEN every leaf and twig. Keep original flowers and blue/gold painted surfaces opaque. This is the source finite margin with its actual unequal sides, not a seamless repeat: do not invent a top band, new flowers, new corners, hidden connecting stems or symmetric counterparts. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork.
